title: 4.7 Every Day, First, and Then
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Say what I, you, we and they do every day, and put two routine actions in order with first and then.
grammar_function: I/you/we/they + base verb + every day. First, I ... Then, I ... No he/she -s and no do/does yet.
prerequisite: 4.5-4.6 routine chunks; 3.2 I, you, we; 1.3 they.
speaking_outcome: Say an everyday routine sentence and two ordered steps.
